versions.subject: Merge PR #4536 from @frack113 - Add New Rules Related To Sysvol Access
versions.detection:
selection:
    FileName|startswith: '\\'
    FileName|contains|all:
        - '\sysvol\'
        - '\Policies\'
filter_main_generic:
    Image|contains:
        - ':\Program Files (x86)\'
        - ':\Program Files\'
        - ':\Windows\explorer.exe'
        - ':\Windows\system32\'
        - ':\Windows\SysWOW64\'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: FileName="\\*" FileName="*\\sysvol\\*" FileName="*\\Policies\\*" NOT (Image IN ("*:\\Program Files (x86)\\*", "*:\\Program Files\\*", "*:\\Windows\\explorer.exe*", "*:\\Windows\\system32\\*", "*:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*"))
